{{Quote|I'm fresh out of bandanas....|Han Solo|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 8">[[Star Wars (1977) 8|''Star Wars'' (1977) 8]]</ref>}}
'''Bandanas''' were articles of clothing worn around the neck that could be used as [[List of phrases and slang/Legends|flag of truce]]. They can also be worn around the head to keep body heat or to stay cool. It could also be worn to communicate secretly. They are not considered a hat.<ref name="ESB">[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization]]</ref>

The [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Gorv Mespit]] wore a bandana while on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=location|Senate Plaza|Coruscant}}</ref>
